description: The same two letters in liberation-sans at 400 and at 700, over a plate. This is the only fixture that exercises a **drawn** family -- one whose weights are separate files the designer drew rather than positions on a variable axis -- and Liberation is the only such family scorsese ships. Three failures are visible here and nowhere else. A build that resolved both weights to the same file draws two identical rows, which is what shipping Liberation as Regular-only used to look like. A build that reached for a `wght` axis Liberation does not have refuses to render at all. And a build that quietly snapped 700 to the nearest drawn weight would pass this while failing the sibling assertion in crates/compositor's `shipped` tests, which is why both exist.
